messages.author: b1480977eebdd500
messages.subject: Deploying and importing my own data (csv files) on shinyapps
parts:
Hi!

Forgive me if this is straightforward.

I have succesfully ran my app locally with my own data in an .csv format in the appDir. I used:

  MyData<-read.table("MyData.csv", sep=" ",row.names=NULL)

Now I have deployed my app, but this does not work. My question: How can I include data in the deployment and 'import' it in the server file.

Best Regards,
Duco

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Deploying and importing my own data (csv files) on shinyapps
parts: Your data file(s) should be in the same directory as your application files (e.g. ui.R and server.R) it will automatically be deployed.

parts:
Yeah, that's right.

Duco, is it possible you didn't get the case exactly right (e.g. MyData.csv vs. mydata.csv)? If you're using Windows locally, then case is ignored, but since ShinyApps is on Linux, case matters.
